findings.finding: Upward-enclosure accounting conflates an operation with one guard, omits operand and result admissions (including zero-shortcut operand guards), and charges next_up only after it executes. A next_up refusal therefore loses partial work, and successful/refused guard totals are not the actual guarded events required by BVLS03.
findings.required_correction: Keep the accepted arithmetic and refusal policy unchanged. Increment an operation before each multiply/add/next_up, and increment one event before each semantic source/result admission regardless of how many finite/normal/underflow predicates that admission evaluates. Account every currently executed outer upward_operand admission as well as helper input/result admissions unless the duplicate call is removed with separately reviewed equivalence. Do not count each predicate as a separate event.

findings.finding: The retained control asserts the 39816 authority bound as executed enclosure work. Debug01 observed 6654 for case 0 and stopped before case 1. The bound is not an executed-cost oracle.
findings.required_correction: Assert the independently reconstructed executed enclosure counts 6654 and 6522, retain 39816 only for dimension admission, and assert scalar ledger totals 58876 and 58744 respectively.

findings.finding: The ordered KKT arithmetic is correctly charged before each of its 1827 operations with three grouped operand/result admissions per operation, but actual guards outside those helpers are omitted: initial lambda admission, repeated h admission, gamma validation, and any executed release-ratio result admission.
findings.required_correction: Charge each actual admission at its existing guard site without adding arithmetic to the fixed K categories. Gamma construction and release-ratio arithmetic remain existing BVLS02 whole-solve work outside K; this review does not claim a complete kernel instruction count.

independent_executed_cost_reconstruction.method: Static nonzero-pattern count of the frozen cbar_and_tau upward_mul/upward_add call graph. For row r, n_r counts nonzero A[r,j] with nonzero p2[j]. B=sum_r(4*n_r+2*[n_r>0]). For coordinate i, q_i counts rows with nonzero A[r,i] and nonzero row_scale. Executed enclosure operations are 21*B + 4*sum_i(q_i) + 2*count_i(q_i>0); lambda is signed zero in both retained faces.
independent_executed_cost_reconstruction.scalar_total_formula: 50266 correction + 129 norms + 1827 ordered KKT + actual enclosure
independent_executed_cost_reconstruction.bound_check: Both executed enclosure counts are below 39816; both scalar totals are below K(20)=92038.
